final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT r.ordervault AS ordervault, u.acctscope AS acctscope, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM riskandmargin r JOIN orders o ON o.recordvault = r.ordervault JOIN users u ON u.userstamp = o.userlink GROUP BY r.ordervault, u.acctscope), s2 AS (SELECT acctscope, SUM(cnt) AS total FROM s1 GROUP BY acctscope), s3 AS (SELECT SUM(total) AS grand FROM s2), s4 AS (SELECT s2.acctscope AS acctscope, s2.total AS total, 1.0 * s2.total / s3.grand AS ratio FROM s2 JOIN s3 ON s3.grand IS NOT NULL), s5 AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avgratio FROM s4) SELECT s4.acctscope, s4.total, s4.ratio, 1.0 * s4.total / s5.avgratio AS final_ratio FROM s4 JOIN s5 ON s5.avgratio IS NOT NULL ORDER BY s4.acctscope
